label: Corpus occurrence graph
failure_mode: Fall back to reusable graph lookup. Missing occurrence analysis means not analyzed, not impossible or absent.
invariants: Canonical prose remains clean; occurrence data is standoff evidence.
Offsets are zero-based, end-exclusive Unicode code points over NFC-normalized text.
Occurrence evidence may reference reusable graph IDs but does not own those reusable objects.
A passage-specific lesson match is evidence only and cannot bypass canonical lesson trigger/readiness/release gating.
